_meta.description: Spanish question translations - To be populated by translator or imported from CSV

_note: This file will be populated by:
_options: 1. Import from CSV: npm run i18n:import-csv -- --file path/to/questions-es.csv --language es
2. Translate manually and import: npm run i18n:import-questions -- --language es
3. Export from database: npm run i18n:export-questions -- --language es
